description: I wanted to reuse context across AI chats instead of re-explaining every time. So I built a small RAG system: store past conversations, embed them, and when you start a new chat you can pull in the relevant bits. Chrome extension captures messages, NestJS + Qdrant + Bull handle the backend, and I used OpenAI to summarize chunks before injection so it stays readable.

Started as a weekend thing and got a bit out of hand. Live HN feed, filters, sorting — and I hooked in the OpenAI API to generate short summaries so you could skim without opening every link. React + Express + Socket.IO for the real-time bit. Good fun.
